content: मुक्तिः {%f.%} [मुच्-क्तिन्] .²1 Release, liberation, deliverance; स मुक्तिः सातिमुक्तिः <ls>Bṛ. Up. 3. 1. 3</ls>. .²2 Freedom, emancipation. .²3 Final beatitude or emancipation, absolution of the soul from metempsychosis; अधिगत्य जगत्यधीश्वरादथ मुक्तिं पुरुषोत्तमात्ततः <ls>N. 2. 1</ls> (where मुक्ति has sense 1 also). .²4 Leaving, giving up, abandoning, avoiding; संसर्गमुक्तिः खलेषु <ls>Bh. 2. 62</ls>. .²5 Throwing, hurling, letting off, discharging. .²6 Unloosing, opening. .²7 Discharge, paying off (as a debt).
